apps.localizedDescription: Independent local-first iPhone assistant with downloadable models, chat history, voice, documents, projects, native tools and local image analysis. Build 8 adds reviewed read-workflow fixes and the native vision/tools runtime. Models download separately. Unsigned iOS 26+ prerelease; SideStore signs it. Package compilation, structure and hash checks passed. Known UI bugs remain; exact-build unit/UI tests and physical-device installation/runtime are unverified. General autonomy, broad vision reliability and automatic cross-device sync remain unfinished; live sync is disabled. Not completed 1.0.0. No paid app tiers; optional remote providers may charge. Not an OpenAI product.

versions.localizedDescription:
Orivyn 0.1.1 build 8 — development preview

Unsigned ARM64 IPA for iOS 26 or later; SideStore signs it for your account and device. Preserve the existing app data and signing identity when updating. Models download separately.

Includes the current local assistant, reviewed read-workflow fixes, native tools/vision runtime, and durable text-sync storage. Live automatic sync is not enabled. General unreviewed autonomy and broad vision reliability remain unfinished. A UI test found that New conversation did not clear the previous response after a real model reply. Physical-device installation, signing refresh, memory/thermal behavior and runtime acceptance remain unverified. This is not completed 1.0.0.

This package passed unsigned device compilation, runtime archive validation, IPA structure/resource checks and independent identity/hash inspection. Native unit/UI tests were not run for this exact package. Parent implementation fb146910 separately passed 1,014 native tests (5 skipped, zero failures), all 129 portable persistence tests and six reviewed-read real-model cases; its general-agent and one UI test failed. Vision's frozen synthetic baseline matched 8/10 cases. None of these results certifies general autonomy, reliable broad vision, automatic sync or physical-device readiness.

Source: a6c696a89a2e5a6224e220b6772b62614d30b4df

Unsigned ARM64 iPhone development preview for iOS 26+. SideStore must sign it for your account/device. This is not completed 1.0.0.

Includes the current local-assistant development candidate, with stricter remote-stream choice validation and reviewed source-patch export. Exported patches are drafts: they are not applied or tested automatically, and the base commit/blob must be checked before use. Models download separately; optional remote providers may charge.

Verified for this source: 400 Foundation Swift tests, 104 JavaScript agent tests, 39 VM component tests, and 158 Python tests passed (one existing tokenizer test skipped). Native iOS Release compilation and IPA structure/resource checks passed on Xcode 26.4.1. Native unit/UI tests were not run for this exact build. Physical iPhone installation/refresh, runtime, voice, memory/thermal behavior and Files export remain unverified. General autonomous tool orchestration, broad vision and automatic cross-device sync remain unfinished.

Source commit: 319d6aed0a4e7543d23f96bb2de882cf68616348. CircleCI packaging pipeline 21, job 28.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Take a photo to attach and recognize its text on this iPhone.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Only when you connect to your chosen plugin server, Orivyn may access that server on your local network. Chats and files are not sent automatically.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Only when you tap Get current location, Orivyn asks iOS for a one-time location displayed on this screen. It is not sent to a model or server.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Orivyn uses the microphone only when you start dictation or a voice conversation.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Orivyn transcribes your speech on this iPhone when you start dictation or voice conversation.
